source: bench/rulebook-nfl.mjs on data/post/nfl, 192 contests $20+ 2026-09-10..09-28 (115k classic lineups); KEEP = |t| >= 3, same sign both halves, 300+ each side

rules.rule: no two identical lineups from this account in one contest
rules.evidence: a copy can only split with yourself

rules.rule: DST must not face your own QB
QB with at least one of his pass catchers
rules.evidence: +36 pts ROI, t 7.2; 93% of the field does it

rules.rule: at least three players owned 20%+ (0-2 chalk is the worst construction in the archive)
QB with two or more pass catchers
a bring-back from the QB's opponent
no RB paired with his own DST
sim ROI in the top half of the field; in $300+ contests avoid the top decile (that is where the field sits)
rules.evidence: top half +14% vs -36%, t 7.9; $300+ top decile -31% vs -6%, t -3.4

rules.rule: expected copies in the field under 1
rules.evidence: bench/fit-dup-nfl.mjs: classic P(copy) 50% once entries x ownership product passes 0.1; the user's entries were duplicated 2-4x the winners' rate
